name: LifeOS
tagline: Continuously records your day as video and turns it into searchable context an AI assistant can use.

awards: TwelveLabs: Best Use of TwelveLabs API (Podium)

problem: AI assistants lack context about the user's life.
solution: Captures continuous video, indexes it with video understanding and a vector database, and exposes it as context for an agent.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask what you did this morning and get highlights.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “TwelveLabs: Best Use of TwelveLabs API (Podium)” among 131 submissions.
Positions itself as context infrastructure, not an app.
Always-on recording raises consent questions for people around the user.

lessons: Infrastructure pitches need one user story to be concrete.
